subject: Urgent: KMS / subprocessor exception blocking DPA signature — need CISO sign-off
messages:
From: Leah Brooks <leah.brooks@finapps.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finapps.com, Procurement Team <procurement@finapps.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood DPA — final redline + KMS ask

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for getting us the updated DPA. We ran a short internal review and attached our consolidated redline (DPA_redline_v3.docx). Two remaining items are blocking signature on our side: a) FinApps requires customer-managed KMS or HSM for keys controlling customer data (we flagged this in security); and b) we need the full list of subprocessors and a commitment window for notification before new subprocessors go live.

Can Redwood accept a limited KMS exception where enterprise accounts can use a customer-managed KMS under a separate addendum? If not, can you confirm whether Redwood will allow on-prem HSM integration for our dedicated deployment? Procurement would like to close the DocuSign by EOW.

Attachments: DPA_redline_v3.docx (track changes), rfi_subprocessors.csv

Leah Brooks
Head of Legal Operations, FinApps
leah.brooks@finapps.com


From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood DPA — final redline + KMS ask

Looping you in — FinApps wants the KMS/HSM exception plus final subprocessor list. Procurement is pushing for EOW signature.

Quick asks:
- Neha: legal/risk perspective on customer-managed KMS or an addendum path? Is this something we can standardize for enterprise?
- Karthik: tech feasibility for HSM or customer key integration on Dedicated/private deployments and RTO/maintenance concerns.

Forwarded message included below. I’ve attached the redline they sent.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood DPA — final redline + KMS ask

Jasmine — thanks for flagging. High level from Legal/Risk:
- We cannot accept a blanket customer-managed KMS for hosted customers (security & key custody model). However, offering a formal KMS addendum for Dedicated or Private deployments (with engineering guardrails) is plausible. This must go through CISO review (exception request) and will require an insurance/SLR assessment.
- Subprocessor disclosure: we can provide the full list, but FinApps wants a commit window for notification. Our standard is 30 days — we can propose 30 days notice + option to opt out for specific sensitive subprocessors via mitigation controls.

I’ll draft suggested language for the addendum and the subprocessor commitment. Marcus/Karthik — please confirm any timeline/ops constraints: how long to support a KMS addendum rollout, and what audit evidence we can provide?

-Neha
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood DPA — final redline + KMS ask

Short technical summary:
- Dedicated / Private: we already support bring-your-own-keys (BYOK) for some enterprise customers via our connector to customer KMS/HSM (limited vendors). Engineering effort to generalize is moderate: ~4-6 weeks for formal packaging and test matrices; ops/process changes for key rotation and incident playbook likely +2 weeks.
- Hosted API: unsupported for customer key control due to multi-tenant architecture. We can offer envelope encryption patterns and stronger tenant isolation, but not full BYOK in hosted.
- Subprocessors.csv (attached) lists current subprocessors and region-level mappings. For the notification window, 30 days is fine operationally.

Attachment: rfi_subprocessors.csv

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Security

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood DPA — final redline + KMS ask

Proposal we can take to FinApps:
1) Accept redline on subprocessors + commit to 30-day notification. Provide rfi_subprocessors.csv and a recurring quarterly digest.
2) Offer a KMS addendum for Dedicated and Private customers (BYOK/HSM) — not available for Hosted. Draft addendum should include: scope (enterprise only), onboarding checklist, SOC2+KMS configuration attestation, and pricing impact.
3) If FinApps requires on-prem HSM for an otherwise-hosted workload, propose migration to Dedicated with a 90-day migration plan and a small migration credit.

Neha — can you put the addendum language in a short DocuSign-friendly PDF? Jasmine — if Procurement insists on EOW signature, we may need to escalate to CISO for exception (time-sensitive). Laura, FYI — this could require commercial concession.

Marcus
Head of Sales, West Region

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: FinApps signature timeline (EOW) — request CISO + Exec sign-off

Team — update: Procurement just replied they need a signed DPA by Friday EOD or they will delay onboarding. I’ve summarized internal position below and copied Neha’s draft ask.

What we can offer today:
- Subprocessors: full list provided (attached), 30-day notification commitment + quarterly digest.
- KMS: BYOK/HSM via Dedicated/Private only. Not supported on Hosted. We will provide a KMS addendum (Neha to draft).
- Migration path: Dedicated migration plan (90 days) + one-time migration credit (commercial to approve).

Open ask for immediate decision:
- Approve a conditional exception to allow FinApps to sign (Procurement wants signature now) with a required migration plan and audit attestation within 60 days, OR instruct me to ask FinApps to convert to Dedicated before signature. We need CISO sign-off on the conditional exception and Exec approval for any credit.

DocuSign link forwarded here: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?env=prod&acct=12345&doc=RDW-4721

If I don’t hear approval by EOD tomorrow I will escalate to CISO and CFO and offer a single-use commercial credit to close.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
